title: helminthotheca echioides var. mollis
intro: Helminthotheca echioides var. mollis, commonly known as Velvet Purslane, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Velvet Purslane include wound healing, skin protection, and the management of conditions such as diarrhea and dysentery. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
